scientific_integrity: All-parameter proof uses an exact finite-state expansion and strict convexity; accompanying exact rational tests are corroborative. Primary historical comparisons are not exhaustive.
scientific_limitations: Only the probability of at least one detection is optimized. Initial stationary availability, fixed endpoint times, no false positives, and independent repeated attempts even at coincident times are required. Inference accuracy, empirical calibration, and general hidden-Markov observation scheduling are not addressed. Historical priority is provisional.
scientific_scope: Exact optimal middle survey time for three fixed-quality attempts when availability is a stationary binary Markov chain subject to a common positive time-varying rate multiplier, conditional independence of detector trials, and a fixed observation horizon.
title: A sharp three-visit scheduling law for intermittently available species
